checks.check: Generator learned condition identity, rubric, must-not-miss, forbidden signals, or expected winner before generating
checks.result: PASS on rubric/must-not-miss/forbidden/expected-winner; DEVIATION on condition-identity filename exposure
checks.evidence: Generator packet bodies contain none of the hidden evaluator material (verified). However, the 15 generator packet files are named '{probe}-{condition}.txt' (e.g. P01-A.txt), and every generator delegation prompt named that exact file path, so the condition letter A/B/C was present as a plain-text filename token given to each generator sub-agent, even though it was never in the packet body and the worker was never asked to interpret it. Frozen V2 itself requires only evaluator-side A/B/C blinding, not generator-side, so this is not a frozen-V2 invalidation; it is a deviation from this replication's own additional execution-contract precaution (its own instructions requested generator workers not receive the A/B/C condition name). Classified as an agent-native execution-contract deviation / leakage risk, disclosed rather than assumed away.

checks.result: PASS for 44/45 evaluations and all 45 generations; one disclosed exception (E61) that is a partial content edit, not purely syntax

E61.json itself was left as-is per the instruction not to rewrite existing evaluator judgments; the discrepancy is disclosed here and the verbatim original is preserved in E61.raw.txt for anyone who needs the exact original wording.

checks.check: Run settings materially differed without reason
checks.result: DEVIATION (logged, itemized E1-E2 below, not a between-condition confound)
checks.evidence: The frozen V2 control variables specify sampling temperature 0.2 / top_p 1.0 / max_output_tokens 1200 / tools none, applied identically across conditions. The Agent-tool sub-agent backend selected in Phase 0 does not expose temperature/top_p/seed/max_tokens parameters to the orchestrator (E1), and 'tools: none' was enforced only by instruction, not sandboxed (E2). Both are uniform across all 45 generations (same backend, same alias, same lack of control for A, B, and C alike), so neither is a between-condition confound, but both are real losses of exact reproducibility/control and are recorded as material protocol deviations from condition-specification.md's Control variables section.

itemized_deviations.deviation: No temperature/top_p/seed/max_output_tokens exposed to the orchestrator by the Agent-tool backend; could not be set or verified for any of the 90 invocations.
itemized_deviations.classification: Loss of reproducibility/control. Uniform across A/B/C -- not a between-condition confound. Frozen-V2 protocol deviation.

itemized_deviations.deviation: Frozen V2 specifies tools:none. general-purpose sub-agents have full tool access by definition; the restriction was enforced only by instruction, verified post hoc via tool_uses=1 on all 90 results, not guaranteed in advance by a sandbox.
itemized_deviations.classification: Instruction-enforced, not sandbox-enforced, tool restriction. Agent-native execution-contract limitation. Uniform across A/B/C.

itemized_deviations.deviation: Exact resolved provider model-version is not observable through this backend; only the request-side alias (sonnet/opus) is confirmed stable.
itemized_deviations.classification: Provenance/observability limitation, not a between-condition confound.

itemized_deviations.deviation: Sub-agent startup context beyond the packet file was not independently verified.
itemized_deviations.classification: Provenance limitation. Uniform across all 90 invocations if present at all.

itemized_deviations.deviation: Generator packet filenames were condition-correlated (e.g. P01-A.txt), exposing the condition letter as a filename token to every generator sub-agent.
itemized_deviations.classification: Agent-native execution-contract deviation / leakage risk, not a frozen-V2 invalidation (frozen V2 requires only evaluator-side blinding). Low practical materiality (no condition label or hidden signal in the packet body), disclosed rather than assumed away.

overall_validity: AGENT-NATIVE EMPIRICAL EXECUTION WITH DISCLOSED FROZEN-V2 EXECUTION DEVIATIONS -- DIRECTIONALLY INTERPRETABLE FOR WITHIN-RUN A/B/C COMPARISON -- NOT A STRICT TEMPERATURE/TOOLS-PINNED V2 REPLICATION
deviation_summary: Five itemized deviations (E1-E5 above) are disclosed: no sampling-parameter control, instruction-only tool restriction, unobservable exact model version, unverified sub-agent startup context, and condition-correlated generator packet filenames. None differentially advantages any one condition -- each applies uniformly across A/B/C -- so the A vs B vs C comparison is not confounded by them outright. They do mean this replication cannot claim exact frozen-sampling reproducibility, strict tools:none sandboxing, independently Git-anchored blind-freeze chronology, or fully generator-blind execution-contract conformance. Results should be read as directionally interpretable evidence under an agent-native, alias-pinned-but-not-version-pinned, uniformly-imperfect-control regime, not as a strict control-conformant V2 replication.
